brief:
Gaza's Health Ministry said Thursday that at least 300 children have died waiting for Israeli permission to leave the territory for life-saving medical treatment, Middle East Eye reported. The deaths include at least 90 children who required cancer treatment but could not access care outside Gaza.

The ministry did not specify the timeframe over which these deaths occurred or provide additional details about the medical conditions involved. Israeli restrictions on exits from Gaza have prevented patients from reaching treatment abroad.

title: At least 300 Gaza children die awaiting Israeli medical exit permits
